comments.name: Olivia Amelia
comments.comment: This is such a useful, honest breakdown — the ferry versus flight comparison for Cebu to Bohol and Cebu to Siargao is exactly what I was trying to work out for my own trip. I loved the point about comparing door to door, not ticket to ticket, because the airport transfer really does change the maths. I planned my trip the same way I plan a parcel delivery: I ordered a few travel bits online, tracked the parcel, and kept all the booking confirmations in one folder. One thing I sorted before I flew was my SIM, and I found the TM SIM registration guide really clear for getting registered before arrival, so I had data working from the first ferry crossing. Thank you for the money-saving moves too — booking four to six weeks out is a tip I will definitely use.
comments.reply: Thank you, Olivia. That's great to know.
